facts.text: The top panel shows a full-body view of an adult person standing on a wet, elevated urban walkway or rooftop at night, with metal railings on both sides and blurred city lights behind.
The person has short dark hair that is shaved at the sides and tied into a small topknot or bun at the back, and a visible small scar above one eyebrow.
The person wears an all-black outfit: a collared tactical jacket with straps, buckles and a zipper, a dark crew-neck top, black cargo trousers, and black lace-up combat boots.
In the top hero panel, the person stands with feet apart and arms relaxed at the sides, with the head turned to look toward the left side of the frame.
The middle row contains three full-body turnaround panels labeled FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, and BACK against a plain dark charcoal background.

The FRONT panel shows the person facing the camera, standing upright with arms at the sides; the SIDE PROFILE panel shows the person in profile facing frame left; and the BACK panel shows the person from behind.
The bottom row contains four close-up detail panels labeled FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, and BOOTS.
The FACE panel shows a close frontal view of the person with a serious, neutral expression, shaved sides of the head, and a scar above one eyebrow.
The JACKET COLLAR panel shows the stand collar, fabric texture, strap, and metal buckle hardware of the black jacket.
The HANDS panel shows two weathered-looking hands with visible veins and grime, with fingers relaxed and slightly curled.
The BOOTS panel shows a close-up of black lace-up leather combat boots with a worn, wet or muddy surface.
The sheet has low-key cinematic lighting, with cool blue-gray night tones, warm amber practical lights in the top panel, and soft directional studio lighting in the turnaround and detail panels.
The visible labels on the sheet read HERO, FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, BACK, FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, and BOOTS.

facts.text: Composite character reference sheet: a large hero image of a dragon occupies the top half, with six labeled detail/orthographic panels arranged in two rows below.

The dragon has charcoal-black scales with muted blue-gray highlights, long backward-swept pale horns, a crest and row of dorsal spikes, large bat-like wings, and clawed feet.
The hero environment is a dark volcanic rocky landscape with glowing orange lava fissures in the background, haze, and shallow water reflecting the dragon’s feet.
A panel labeled “FRONT” shows the dragon facing forward with both wings spread to either side and the tail visible behind.
A panel labeled “SIDE PROFILE” shows the full dragon from the side with its wings partly raised and its long tail extended behind.
A panel labeled “REAR” shows the dragon from behind with its wings spread wide and dorsal spikes running down the back.
A panel labeled “HEAD CLOSE” shows a close view of the dragon’s horned head, scaled face, and visible amber-colored eye.
A panel labeled “WING MEMBRANE” isolates the textured, veined wing membrane stretched between dark skeletal supports.
A panel labeled “CLAW AND FOOT” shows a close view of a scaly foot with prominent curved claws resting on dark rock.
A panel labeled “SCALE DETAIL” shows tightly overlapping dark scales with blue-gray iridescent highlights.
